issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif.svg?style=flat-square&logo=github&color=red)](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/issues) This is a tool that allows you to record a selected area of your **screen**, the contents of a **webcam**, the current drawings from a **sketchboard** or **live drawings** of your desktop and afterwards **edit and save the recordings as a GIF**, APNG or video. > [](https://www.microsoft.com/store/apps/9n3sqk8pds8g?cid=Gith) ## Features * Powerful editor with lots of options, including the ability to add overlay elements (Free Text, Drawing, Key strokes, Border, Title Frame, Cinemagraph, Text Shadows, etc.) * Saves to Gif, Apng, AVI, MKV, MOV, MP4, WebM, Webp, PSD, Image and project files * Advanced options for video formats, including hardware encoding (via Intel, AMD, or Nvidia GPUs) * A simple UI and user-experience (but also lets you customize a lot of things) * Multiple types of captures, including Screen, Webcam, Board and free-hand drawings * FFMpeg, Gifski and System encoders (under .Net and WPF) * Multiple languages

## Download Go to the [releases](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/releases) and get the latest version (choose the portable version if you don't have admin access). [](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/releases) [](https://www.microsoft.com/store/apps/9n3sqk8pds8g?cid=Gith) [](https://chocolatey.org/packages/screentogif) [](https://www.fosshub.com/ScreenToGif.html) --- Do you want to become a **patron** and receive **early access to beta versions**? patreon.com/nicke
## Status |[![Nightly](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/actions/workflows/main.yml/badge.svg?branch=dev&event=push)](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/actions/workflows/main.yml)|[![Stable](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/actions/workflows/release.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/actions/workflows/release.yml)|[![MS Store](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/actions/workflows/store.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif/actions/workflows/store.yml)| |-|-|-| ## Requirements * .Net 6 (OS-specific bundle available, no installation needed) ## This is how you can help * Translate the app to your language * Suggest or implement new features * Find and fix bugs * Create new artwork for the app (text shadows, watermarks, overlays, borders) * Create an animated [icon](https://github.com/NickeManarin/ScreenToGif-Website/blob/master/app/img/logo/Icon.png) for the app This is **ScreenToGif**, a .NET/WPF application for recording screen content and saving it as GIF, APNG, or video formats. The project is structured as a C# solution with multiple projects: - **ScreenToGif** - Main application (UI/WPF) - **ScreenToGif.Model** - Data models - **ScreenToGif.Native** - Native/interop code - **ScreenToGif.Util** - Utilities and helpers I'm ready to explore this codebase further and help design implementation plans for any requirements you have. Just let me know what you'd like me to analyze or plan.
